headline: Securing Boat Cruises and Backcountry Access at Maligne
reservation: A valid Parks Canada Discovery Pass is required for entry into Jasper National Park. Specific activities, such as the Maligne Lake boat cruise or Spirit Island tours, require separate timed bookings; backcountry camping at sites like Hidden Cove must be reserved through the national park system well in advance.

days.title: Glacial Valleys and Canyons

stops.name: Maligne Canyon
stops.detail: Walk the limestone bridges to witness the power of the river as it drops into one of the deepest canyons in the Rockies.

stops.name: Medicine Lake
stops.detail: Observe the unique 'disappearing' lake, where water drains through an underground karst system.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour for the drive from Jasper to Maligne Lake with stops; watch for wildlife on the road.
days.note: Medicine Lake water levels vary significantly by month; early summer is highest.

days.title: Icons of the High Rockies
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM from Maligne Lake Lodge

stops.name: Spirit Island
stops.detail: Access this iconic viewpoint via the official cruise or a long-distance paddle to see the peaks of the Maligne Valley.

stops.name: Mary Schaffer Trail
stops.detail: An easy lakeside walk offering interpretive plaques about the early explorers and geological history of the area.

days.driving: No vehicle access beyond the lodge area; local travel is by boat or on foot.
days.note: Spirit Island is a sacred site; visitors must stay on designated paths and docks.

days.title: Alpine Ridges and Skyline

stops.name: Bald Hills Trail
stops.detail: Hike upward for an expansive view of the entire 22km lake and the surrounding glaciers.

stops.name: Moose Lake Loop
stops.detail: A shorter forested path that leads to a small kettle lake, frequently visited by resident moose.

days.driving: Minimal; trailheads are located near the primary parking areas at the north end of the lake.
days.note: High altitude trails may remain snow-covered until late June; check trail reports.

intel.title: Peak Demand
intel.text: The main lots at the lake fill quickly during midday in summer; arrive early or utilize regional shuttle services if available.

intel.title: Remote Valley
intel.text: Expect no cellular service along the Maligne Lake Road or at the lake itself; download maps before leaving Jasper.

intel.title: Jasper Supply Hub
intel.text: The town of Jasper is the last location for fuel and food; there are no gas stations at Maligne Lake.

intel.title: Tour Schedules
intel.text: Boat cruises operate seasonally, usually from late May through early October depending on ice melt.

intel.title: Wildlife Closures
intel.text: Seasonal closures may affect certain trails to protect caribou or during bear activity; check the Jasper National Park bulletin.

plan.arrival: Fly into YEG, drive west to Jasper for check-in and supplies, then take the Maligne Lake Road for the final leg of the journey.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are fine for the paved Maligne Lake Road; RVs should use designated parking stalls and check for length restrictions.
plan.goldenHour: Spirit Island for late afternoon light (accessible via tour) or the Maligne Lake boathouse for early morning reflections.
